description: This file defines an abstract class 'RequestCallback' in the 'torch::distribtued::rpc' namespace, which serves as a callback interface for processing RPC messages in a distributed PyTorch setup. It declares an operator() for invoking the callback and a pure virtual method processMessage to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: RequestCallback
classes.description: Abstract base class for processing RPC messages, requiring subclasses to implement 'processMessage' to handle the core processing logic.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the callback to process an RPC message, taking a 'Message' reference and a vector of 'c10::Stream's, returning an intrusive pointer to a 'JitFuture'.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented by subclasses, which processes the received 'Message' and associated streams, returning a future for the response.
